verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the GitHub README saying Weaviate combines vector similarity search with keyword filtering in one query interface, and the llms.txt probe noting that it stores inverted indexes. Together these imply some filtering capability, but nothing documents the rich filter conditions the story asks for. Missing for 10: range filters, geo filters, nested boolean (And/Or) logic, array-membership operators, first-party filter docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
